pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

crown.desc: the King's crown: five gold points with pearl tips, a ruby and two sapphires, a checkered band; pivot at the middle of its base (sit it on the head or cap)

microphone.desc: Lakky's microphone: a round metal grille on a black handle; pivot at the grip

lights_0.desc: the start lights, all off; pivot between the hooks, where the rod's line ties on

lights_1.desc: the start lights, one red; pivot between the hooks, where the rod's line ties on

lights_2.desc: the start lights, two red; pivot between the hooks, where the rod's line ties on

lights_3.desc: the start lights, three red; pivot between the hooks, where the rod's line ties on

lights_go.desc: the start lights, all green: GO; pivot between the hooks, where the rod's line ties on

trophy.desc: the Grand Prix's trophy: a gold cup with a star on a black checkered plinth, its lid flat at y 13.6; pivot on the ground at its middle

trophy_piece.desc: the compass piece standing on the trophy's lid (pivot at its foot: at (0, 13.6) on the trophy)

wheel.desc: Big Green 01's steering wheel, stolen: black rim, steel spokes, a green boss; pivot at its middle

tarp.desc: the tarp over Big Green 01 (34 long, faces -x like the kart): its hem at y 3.2 to 4.4, so the kart's wheels show under it; pivot on the ground at its middle

shutter.desc: the Parts Depot's roll-up shutter, jammed crooked (its foot 1.6 to 4.0 above the floor); pivot at the middle of its top edge, so it rolls up (sy) toward it
